n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

    visited[start] = True
    while queue:

                queue.append(neighbor)
                node_lists[neighbor].add(node)

    # Add operations to the lists of all nodes in the subtrees
    queue = deque([a])
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        node_lists[node].add(b)
        for neighbor in edges[node]:
            if neighbor != a:
                queue.append(neighbor)

        node = queue.popleft()
        node_lists[node].add(a)
        for neighbor in edges[node]:

    queue = deque([start])

        node = queue.popleft()
        for neighbor in edges[node]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                visited[neighbor] = True
                queue.append(neighbor)
                node_lists[neighbor].add(node)
                node_lists[node].add(neighbor)

# Perform BFS from node 1
bfs(1)

# Process operations
for a, b in operations:
    # Add operations to the lists of all nodes in the subtrees
    queue = deque([a])
